PLAN "Two-Week Travel Maintenance Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "hypertrophy maintenance while traveling"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper body maintenance":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body maintenance":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          forward_step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 each_leg rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Friday training 30m "Push-pull circuit":
        warmup:
          shoulder_rolls 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          arnold_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          resistance_band_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Sunday training 25m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds each side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          bicycle_crunch 3x20 (each side) rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_twist 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper body maintenance progression":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Lower body maintenance":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          forward_step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 each_leg rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Friday training 30m "Push-pull circuit":
        warmup:
          shoulder_rolls 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dip 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday rest 0m "Rest/Recovery"
      DAY Sunday training 25m "Core & mobility":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45 seconds rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds each side rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          russian_twist 3x20 (each side) rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_twist 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 60 seconds`.
